stories.title: Meet Eugene Torre, the pioneering Asian GM who beat Karpov and befriended Fischer
stories.summary: Viswanathan Anand became Asia’s third Grandmaster in 1988. Eugene Torre, the first from the continent to get that most important title for chess players, did it in 1974. He was also the first Asian to play at the Candidates, the qualifying event for the World Championship. He featured in 23 Olympiads for Philippines.

stories.title: WPL final | Mumbai Indians defeat Delhi Capitals by 7 wickets to win the inaugural edition of Women’s Premier League
stories.summary: The women of Mumbai Indians certainly have arrived. They have not just lived up to their imaginative marketing campaign featuring that catchy song (Aali Re…). stories.title: 1st Test: India's WTC final hopes suffer as resolute New Zealand salvage draw

stories.title: 'For Our U19 Team': Hasan Nawaz Dedicates Pakistan's Win Over India A To U19 Team After Asia Cup Final Heartbreak
stories.summary: Pakistan cricketer Hasan Nawaz dedicated his team's victory over India A in the Rising Stars Asia Cup to the Pakistan U19 team. The young Pakistan side had suffered a defeat against India in the U19 Asia Cup final just a week earlier. "For the star on my chest - for our U19 team - for Pakistan ," Nawaz wrote in his caption.

stories.title: Miley Cyrus marries Maxx Morando in California ceremony
stories.summary: Miley Cyrus has married her partner of four years Maxx Morando during a ceremony in Palm Springs, California. Photos of the wedding on Saturday show the ceremony took place by a swimming pool with the pair standing under an arch covered in white flowers. The singer's mother, Tish Cyrus, and sister, Noah Cyrus, were in attendance, Entertainment Tonight reported.

stories.title: Explained: Why Climate Talks Failed At Longest COP31
stories.summary: Close The COP31 climate summit in Turkey has officially come to an end after countries failed to come to a consensus on a new deal. The European Union and some other countries rejected a fourth draft agreement over its failure to mention a need to phase out fossil fuels, the largest driver of global climate change.

stories.title: What does noisome mean?
stories.summary: First, let us deal with the pronunciation of the word. The first syllable ‘noi’ rhymes with ‘boy’, ‘toy’ and ‘joy’; the following ’s’ is like the ’s’ in ‘sit’, ‘set’ and ‘sip, while the ’o’ is like the ‘a’ in ‘china’. The word is pronounced ‘NOY-sem’ with the stress on the first syllable.

stories.title: Everyday Explained: Why do wooden doors swell during monsoons and become difficult to shut?
stories.summary: From humidity to moisture absorption, an expert explains why wooden doors swell during monsoons and become difficult to shut. A door that closes effortlessly one day may suddenly start getting stuck in its frame when the rains arrive. This common monsoon inconvenience is not necessarily a sign of poor carpentry or damaged hinges.

stories.title: A solo traveller’s guide to San Francisco: 6 ways to experience the city on your own
stories.summary: Planning a solo trip to San Francisco? Explore scenic parks, iconic attractions, fascinating museums, local restaurants and lively nightlife across the city. Travelling solo in San Francisco can be as exciting as a holiday with friends or family. The Californian city offers plenty for independent travellers, from scenic cycling routes and waterfront attractions to art museums, neighbourhood food spots, and live music venues.

stories.title: Prime-number puzzle & fluid equations: The two math problems claimed to be solved with AI | HT Explainers
stories.summary: Researchers said on Friday that artificial intelligence (AI) had helped them crack two problems that have defeated mathematicians for generations: the Riemann hypothesis, about prime numbers, and a central question about the Navier-Stokes equations , which describe how fluids move. Mathematicians are divided over what such proofs are worth when a computer has checked them but no person has read them in full.

stories.title: From kala pani to Rikers, history of island prisons and the waters used to lock people in | HT Explainers
stories.summary: In Alexandre Dumas's The Count of Monte Cristo, the young sailor Edmond Dantès works out where the gendarmes are rowing him only as the boat nears the Château d'If, a fortress on a rock off Marseille. stories.summary: The Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT) has exempted the Sakhalin-1 Unincorporated Joint Venture—involving ONGC Videsh Ltd and four foreign partners—from capital gains tax. The exemption, notified on 19 November, takes effect retrospectively from 1 April 2023. It could provide tax relief to ONGC Videsh for its investment in Russia’s Sakhalin-1 oil and gas project following a restructuring of ownership.

stories.title: ‘Home-sick’: Mumbai exhibition explores Himalayan medicinal plants and disappearing habitats
stories.summary: By definition, homesickness refers to the unhappiness one experiences when away from home for an extended period. However, for Garima Gupta, an artist and researcher based in New Delhi, the term takes on a more layered meaning. Through her exhibition Home-sick, currently on view at TARQ, Gupta considers sickness as both a symptom and a witness — a condition through which stories of exhaustion, displacement and care become perceptible.
